verdict.rationale: Viam's own CLI documents deleting captured data, including bulk operations on data matching a filter, so the deletion half of the story is a first-party capability. Nothing in the pack shows configurable retention periods or policies. The automatic handling of local storage constraints is not user retention control. missing for 10: documented retention-policy configuration (TTL/expiry), detail on deletion scope and guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: you can export data in a variety of formats, query tabular or binary data with SQL or MQL, delete data, add or remove tags from all data that matches a given filter
query tabular or binary data with SQL or MQL, delete data
